```python
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    m = Model("Transportation_Problem")
    m.setParam("TimeLimit", 100)  # Set time limit to 100 seconds

    # Data
    sources = list(range(3))  # S0..S2
    destinations = list(range(3))  # D0..D2

    supplies = [1, 1, 1]
    demands = [1, 1, 1]

    # Cost matrix: rows correspond to sources S0..S2, columns to destinations D0..D2
    costs = [
        [ 12.57,  25.94,   7.85],  # S0
        [ 13.77,  18.55,  21.67],  # S1
        [ 24.82,  17.47,  22.26],  # S2
    ]

    # Decision variables:
    # Flow_S{i}_D{j} >= 0 is the quantity shipped from source i to destination j
    flows = {}
    for i in sources:
        for j in destinations:
            flows[(i, j)] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name=f"Flow_S{i}_D{j}")

    # Objective: Minimize total transportation cost
    m.setObjective(
        quicksum(costs[i][j] * flows[(i, j)] for i in sources for j in destinations),
        GRB.MINIMIZE
    )

    # Supply constraints: Shipments from each source <= its supply
    for i in sources:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(flows[(i, j)] for j in destinations) <= supplies[i],
            name=f"Supply_S{i}"
        )

    # Demand constraints: Shipments to each destination >= its demand
    for j in destinations:
        m.addConstr(
            quicksum(flows[(i, j)] for i in sources) >= demands[j],
            name=f"Demand_D{j}"
        )

    m.optimize()
    return m
```
